reason: Both are US-focused building-product manufacturers selling through distributors to contractors for commercial construction. Carlisle's core is roofing membranes, polyiso insulation and weatherproofing. CSW sells HVAC/R accessories, plumbing and electrical products, architectural components (firestopping, railings, rooftop supports) and specialty lubricants. The product overlap is limited to a few building-envelope-adjacent items. The customer overlap is partial: roofing and envelope contractors and building owners versus HVAC, plumbing and electrical trades plus industrial and energy users. So it is adjacent, not a direct competitor.
